definitions: To catch one's foot on something and stumble or fall.
To make a mistake or error.
To activate a mechanism, especially an electrical one, causing it to switch off.
To go on a journey or excursion.
To experience the effects of a hallucinogenic drug.
examples: Be careful not to trip on the rug.
He might trip over his words during the speech.
The circuit breaker will trip if there's an overload.
They plan to trip around Europe next summer.
Some people trip on magic mushrooms.
